title: Sample manual chunk
text:
The fleet type submarine was designed for long-range independent operations in support of the fleet, with the endurance to reach distant patrol areas and remain there.

This is a sample record standing in for the 1946 manual series. The full corpus, 2,189 chunks, is in corpora/ and is a public-domain US Navy work.
